newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Masco a Merrill Focus One.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Masco a Merrill Focus One.

text.p: Merrill Lynch analyst Jonathan Goldfarb said he upgraded home improvement and building products maker Masco Corp to a near-term buy from accumulate, keeping it as a long-term buy.
-- named it a Merrill Focus One stock.
-- said company continues to exceed expectations, citing "very strong" second quarter results.
-- said raised 1997 earnings per share estimate to $2.30-$2.35 from $2.25 and boosted 1998 to $2.75 from $2.50.
-- set six-to-12 month price target of $52-1/2 on stock, which closed Tuesday at 42-15/16.
